players.product: memory packaging and test (DRAM / NAND, modules)

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: consolidated Q2 2026 revenue of KRW 683,159,243,026 against KRW 340,178,666,798 in Q2 2025, with operating profit of KRW 142,321,958,811 versus KRW 30,213,756,660; H1 2026 revenue of KRW 1,190,835,457,328 against KRW 651,951,407,078 a year earlier and H1 operating profit of KRW 214,362,705,297 versus KRW 41,954,328,959; H1 net income KRW 157,940,335,266 versus KRW 7,663,397,545

Segment results: the semiconductor manufacturing segment (packaging, test and modules, at the parent, HT Micron in Brazil and Hana Micron Vina in Vietnam) grew H1 2026 revenue 90% year on year to KRW 1,007.3 billion and operating profit 575% to KRW 167.0 billion, which the company attributes to its delivery and quality competitiveness and its process-technology edge in mobile and server DRAM; the semiconductor materials segment (subsidiary Hana Materials' silicon and SiC etch-chamber parts) grew revenue 49% to KRW 182.3 billion and operating profit 170% to KRW 46.8 billion. H1 revenue mix: packaging (PKG) KRW 941,365,465 thousand (79.1%), other manufacturing KRW 65,982,246 thousand (5.5%), silicon parts KRW 163,064,634 thousand (13.7%), other materials KRW 19,283,716 thousand (1.6%). Management plans to expand high value-added memory products and its non-memory packaging, test and module business
quarterly_data.figure: manufacturing H1 revenue +90% to KRW 1,007.3 billion, operating profit +575% to KRW 167.0 billion; materials revenue +49% to KRW 182.3 billion; PKG 79.1% of revenue

quarterly_data.signal: Customer concentration (undisclosed names): in the semiconductor manufacturing segment Customer A generated KRW 479,312,654 thousand (40.25% of consolidated revenue) and Customer B KRW 306,782,132 thousand (25.76%) in H1 2026, against 48.14% and 14.74% a year earlier (H1 2025 materials-segment Customer C was 12.14%). The report names Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix as the main customers of the packaging business, which also buy packaging from Amkor Korea, ASE Korea, SFA Semiconductor and Signetics; the company says order volumes and product ranges from Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix keep increasing and expects the trend to continue, while it widens its customer base to foundries and fabless companies
quarterly_data.figure: Customer A 40.25% (KRW 479,312,654 thousand), Customer B 25.76% (KRW 306,782,132 thousand) of H1 2026 revenue

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity and utilisation in H1 2026: semiconductor packaging, test and module capacity of 1,336,500 thousand units (330K units per hour, 22.5 hours a day, 30 days a month) against production of 1,091,917 thousand units, an average utilisation of 81.70% (FY2025 production 1,923,089 thousand units on 2,673,000 thousand capacity); silicon-parts lines ran at 83.70%. Average packaging selling price in H1 was KRW 475 domestic and KRW 186 export per unit, against KRW 377 and KRW 194 for FY2025
quarterly_data.figure: utilisation 81.70% (production 1,091,917 thousand units on capacity 1,336,500 thousand); silicon parts 83.70%

quarterly_data.signal: Geographic shift toward Brazil: H1 2026 revenue from customers located in Brazil was KRW 387,690,062 thousand against KRW 100,792,535 thousand a year earlier, and Korea KRW 768,675,413 thousand against KRW 534,342,858 thousand. The parent's equity-method profit from Brazilian packaging and test subsidiary HT Micron Semicondutores rose to KRW 112,788,425 thousand from KRW 27,294,696 thousand, while Vietnamese subsidiary Hana Micron Vina (the SK Hynix back-end outsourcing site) posted an equity-method loss of KRW 3,836,886 thousand; the parent sold KRW 355,542,216 thousand to Hana Micron Vina and KRW 222,180,590 thousand to HT Micron in H1
quarterly_data.figure: Brazil revenue KRW 387,690,062 thousand (H1 2025: KRW 100,792,535 thousand); HT Micron equity-method profit KRW 112,788,425 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: Investment: consolidated property, plant and equipment additions of KRW 68,226,564 thousand in H1 2026 (machinery KRW 25,814,036 thousand, construction in progress KRW 35,664,423 thousand), the materials segment investing KRW 10,173 million in new, expanded and supplementary buildings and equipment for Si and SiC parts; the board approved a USD 5,000,000 capital increase into packaging and test subsidiary Hana Micron Vietnam on 2026-05-27, completed by period end. R&D spending was KRW 29,112,010 thousand, 2.44% of revenue
quarterly_data.figure: PP&E additions KRW 68,226,564 thousand; materials capex KRW 10,173 million; R&D KRW 29,112,010 thousand (2.44% of revenue)

quarterly_data.signal: Advanced packaging R&D: an SAP-based organic bridge die platform with fine-pitch (2/2um) high-density RDL, an 8-metal-layer organic dielectric build and a TMV structure replacing TSV, aimed at commercialising high-performance 2.xD packages and low-cost SoC-to-memory interconnect; and a UCIe chiplet package in which the UCIe Standard package achieved 16Gbps function and a UCIe Advanced RDL (6 metals, L/S 2/2um) interposer and 2.5D daisy-chain package were built and electrically connected, with a 32Gbps functional package targeted as a basis for low-cost 2.5D chiplet packaging
quarterly_data.figure: organic bridge die RDL 2/2um, 8 metal layers; UCIe Standard 16Gbps achieved, 32Gbps UCIe Advanced package targeted

contracts.signal: On 2021-11-12 Vietnamese subsidiary Hana Micron Vina signed a semiconductor back-end outsourced-processing contract with SK Hynix (contract term to 2029-12-31), and Hana Micron signed a business cooperation agreement with SK Hynix guaranteeing it: Hana Micron jointly guarantees all of Vina's obligations to SK Hynix up to KRW 1 trillion (outsourced processing contract KRW 600 billion, equipment lease contract KRW 400 billion), may not transfer Vina shares to competitors without SK Hynix's prior written consent, and must give SK Hynix a right of first purchase on any partial sale; the financing obligations were fulfilled in 2022 and no breach exists at period end. A separate basic transaction agreement for semiconductor packaging with SK Hynix dates from 2004-06-01 and renews automatically
contracts.units: back-end outsourced processing and equipment lease at Hana Micron Vina, 2021-11-12 to 2029-12-31
contracts.value: performance guarantee up to KRW 1 trillion (outsourced processing KRW 600 billion, equipment lease KRW 400 billion)

contracts.signal: Hana Micron holds a basic transaction agreement for semiconductor packaging with Samsung Electronics dating from 2001-11-01 that renews automatically, and basic transaction and outsourcing unit-price contracts for outsourced processing with Samsung Electronics and others
